name: The Walking Statuary
introDiscord:
A sculpture garden fills the palace courtyard.

Most statues remain exactly where statues belong.

Several do not.
introTwitch:
A sculpture garden fills the palace courtyard.

Most statues remain exactly where statues belong.

Several do not.

the-walking-statuary-approach.prompt: The Walking Statuary opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
One Berry rests on the pedestal of a statue labeled:

SIR BARRELTON, DEFENDER OF—

Shizuki crossed out the rest.

'Sir Barrelton is mine now.'

right.message: A sculptor's supply chest contains Star Candies.

forward.message:
A marble knight steps off its pedestal.

Art has become interactive.

the-walking-statuary-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Walking Statuary, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A Broken Statue Walker charges between the sculptures.

right.message:
Shizuki's restorative sits beside a headless statue:

'Was already headless.

Important legal clarification.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A hollow pedestal contains Star Candies.

the-walking-statuary-threshold.prompt: Near Sculptor's Tribunal, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: An unfinished sculpture conceals a royal coffer.

right.message:
A statue waits until you pass before stepping down.

Cheap gallery trick.

forward.message:
Shizuki's medicine:

'For statue-related injuries.

This category should not exist.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

boss-antechamber.name: Sculptor's Tribunal
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every statue in Sculptor's Tribunal turns toward the central pedestal.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every statue in Sculptor's Tribunal turns toward the central pedestal.

The largest statue steps down.

Use /yes to face the collection's masterpiece or /no to
leave art criticism to professionals.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every statue in Sculptor's Tribunal turns toward the central pedestal.

The largest statue steps down.

Use !yes to face the collection's masterpiece or !no to
leave art criticism to professionals.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Sculptor's Tribunal. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The Tyrant returns to stone.

Sir Barrelton remains untouched.

Most important sculpture secured.
